mainEntity.name: o I need to be experienced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. These workshops suit everyone from complete beginners to advanced photographers, and because the tuition is genuinely one-to-one, it's tailored to wherever you are. If you'd like extra support, I also offer private lessons and mentoring .

Because these are short workshops, there isn't the option to wait out the weather over several days, so the rule is straightforward. If the forecast before the workshop shows heavy rain right through the start-to-finish window, I may reschedule for another date. On the day, if it rains we'll shoot for as long as it's practical — often it's just a passing shower — but if it sets in for a prolonged spell we may have to call it. My rule of thumb: if we've completed at least half the workshop, that's just bad luck and there's no reshoot or reschedule; if we've done less than half, you'll receive a credit to put towards another workshop.

mainEntity.name: How fit do I need to be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every workshop carries a fitness rating (Easy, Moderate or Hard), shown in the summary details, so you can pick one that suits you. If you're unsure whether a particular workshop is right, just ask before booking and I'll talk you through what to expect.

mainEntity.name: What camera and kit do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A DSLR or mirrorless camera and any lenses you have. A tripod is essential, but I can lend you one (and a set of filters) if you let me know in advance. There's a full kit list in the Equipment section above, and my recommended equipment page goes into more detail.

mainEntity.name: How do I get there, and is travel included?

acceptedAnswer.text: These are self-drive workshops, so you make your own way to the meeting point. Where a workshop visits more than one location, you'll drive yourself between them — I'll always make sure everyone knows where we're heading next. Travel and any parking or entry fees aren't included in the workshop price.

mainEntity.name: Can I pay in instalments, or buy this as a gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes to both — there's an interest-free payment plan , and every workshop is available as a gift voucher .
If there's anything you can't find an answer to, just get in touch — I'm always happy to help.
